Definition: properly, to smear over (with oil), i.e. anoint
BiblicalUsage: 1) to anoint, pour in anointing; 1a) (Qal) to anoint; 1a1) to anoint oneself; 1a2) to anoint (another); 1a3) to be poured; 1b) (Hiphil) to anoint
